First, note the given date: 08-31-1384 (MM-DD-YYYY).  
51 weeks and 1 day = 51 × 7 + 1 = 358 days.  
Subtract 358 days from 1384-08-31.  

1384 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but using Gregorian rules as instructed).  
August 31 is day 244 of the year (Jan 31 days, Feb 29 days, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 → 31+29+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 244).  

244 − 358 = −114 days.  
So go back into 1383.  
1383 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Days in 1383: 365.  
365 − 114 = 251 days into 1383.  

251st day of 1383:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30.  
Sum through August: 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days.  
251 − 243 = 8 days into September.  
So date is 1383-09-08.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1383-09-08
